verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud platform, so programmatic rule and list management is a fair axis. The evidence only shows order-event submission, per-order decision retrieval, chargebacks and webhooks. The single mention of Decision Center says policies can be configured at a checkpoint, with no API for creating velocity rules, editing blocklists or reading overall posture. Nothing in the pack documents human approval gates for agent-proposed changes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my fraud posture and manage rules and lists programmatically — propose a velocity rule, update a blocklist — with human approval gates
